card.text: Explore Lutetia with its Rosetta shape model and source-derived elevation.

introduction.text: Rosetta photographed Lutetia in 2010. Craters and ridges cover this irregular, roughly 100 km asteroid.

osiris.title: OSIRIS photographs
osiris.summary: Two Rosetta close-ups show Lutetia’s craters and ridges, taken 48 seconds apart during the 2010 flyby. The grid marks areas without usable photographs.

shape.title: OSIRIS shape reconstruction
shape.summary: Rosetta shape detail in the north, coarser estimates elsewhere. Source seams remain; no imagery is mapped.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height relative to a 49 km sphere. Rosetta resolved the north; the far side is coarser, with source defects.
